rationale: Comprehensive reconnaissance: schema and completeness (all_columns captures fully-null dx3-5 columns and extensive DRG nulls), key uniqueness across all candidate keys including adherence composite, temporal ranges and date-order consistency checks, join verification across all specified pairs. Report with denominators, artifact citations, and complete caveats (descriptive_only, synthetic_data, sample_preview) for transparency and clarity about data provenance and sample interpretation.
changes_summary: Added synthetic_data and sample_preview caveats to write_report component parameters. This addresses feedback on missing communication about the synthetic nature of the data and clarification that value samples shown are previews, not findings. Both disclosures are essential context for downstream analysis tasks.
